home.hero_desc: Design and manufacture of automotive parts and commercialization of high precision metal products with CNC technology.
home.intro_desc: Since its founding in 2006, Maindsteel Automotive has positioned itself as a leader in the design and manufacture of automotive parts and commercialization of metal products for multiple applications. At Maindsteel we move forward with the strength of our values, betting on continuous innovation in technology and development, but above all, relying on our human factor which is our engine to develop new projects focused on providing efficient metal solutions to the market.
home.card1_desc: We design and manufacture automotive parts based on a Quality Management system certified ISO 9001:2015 and IATF 16949.
home.card2_desc: We offer comprehensive guarantee in all our services and components conformed with excellence and world-class engineering.
home.card3_desc: Proud to be an international class Mexican company, an industrial icon from the state of Aguascalientes.
